On one hand, rewarding good behavior can be positive reinforcement, encouraging the child to keep performing well. It's a way to acknowledge their effort and success. But on the other hand, if the child is expecting a reward every time they get good grades, it might undermine intrinsic motivation. They might start studying just for the reward rather than for the love of learning.
